spans.s:
जुर् 1. जुर् (related to 1. जॄ), cl. 6. 4. P.,
Ved. जुरति, जूर्यति, जुजोर (?), &c., to
decay, become old or decrepit, to grow old, perish;
also जूर्, cl. 4. A. जूर्यते, to grow old.
2. जुर्, ऊर्, m. an old man; [cf. 2. जू.]

जूर् जूर्, cl. 4. A. जूर्यते, &c., to hurt,
injure, wound, kill; to be angry with (with
dat.); to grow old. See rt. 1. जुर्, p. 349.

जुर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, becoming old; [cf. अ-जुर्य
and जूर्य.]

जूर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. becoming old, aged,
weak, an old man.

जूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, decayed, old.
—जूर्णाख्य
(˚ण-आख्˚), अस्, m. the plant Saccharum Cylindricum,
commonly Ulū.
—जूर्णाह्वय (˚ण-आह्˚), अस्, m.
the plant Andropogon Saccharatus.
जूर्ण जूर्ण, जूर्य. See rt. 1. जुर्, p. 349.
जूर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्. See rt. 1. जुर्, p. 349, col. 3.
जूर्णी, f., Ved., N. of a snake.

जूर्णि 1. जूर्णि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. जुर् = गुर्), Ved.
skilfully praising, invoking.

2. जूर्णि, इस्, f., Ved. glowing fire, a blaze, a fiery
weapon; anger [cf. जूर्]; speed (perhaps for जूति);
fever [cf. ज्वर]; disease, sickness; the body; the
sun; Brahmā.

जूर्व् जूर्व् (connected with rt. ज्वर्), cl. 1.
P., Ved. जूर्वति, &c., to consume by heat,
singe, burn; to hurt, kill; [cf. Hib. gearbaim, ‘I
grieve, hurt, wound;’ cf. also rt. ज्वल्.]

जूर्णिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. surrounded by glowing
fire, glowing.

जूर्ति, इस्, f. fever; feverish or morbid heat; [cf.
Hib. gurt, ‘pain, trouble, fierceness.’]
